_comment: Slice 433 item 6, cut point per recording, recorded INSIDE the flow (iPad run 45582715957 showed the wall-clock mark was 60 s of driver start). ios-sim-store-shots.sh runs every clip in one Maestro invocation (the driver starts once): each clip is one generated flow, runFlow of the unrecorded store-shot-ios-videoprep-<clip>.yaml (all navigation, dialogs, waits), then startRecording, the steps of store-shot-ios-video-<clip>.yaml, then stopRecording. From that flow's commands.json (Maestro's own step times) it writes store-dino-<device label>-video-<clip>.mark, two lines: the mark = the end (markAt end) or start (markAt start) of the clip's markStep-th recorded step (1 = the first step after startRecording) and the span = how long the recorder ran, both in seconds from the end of startRecording (the recording's t = 0). A clip is cut from max(0, mark - beforeMark) for `seconds`; the recorder must have run at least that far (store-media.mjs check, which also needs ffprobe), and a still tail the file does not hold (simctl ends the file at the last screen change) is held by the cut. snap nextChange: the cut is anchored on the recording's first screen change after the mark instead of the mark itself (the frame times, ffprobe); used where a hook starts the action, because the app acted 0.3 to 3.3 s after the openLink step started (runs 45597845229, 45597851145, 45607845756, 45607850849), and a recording with no change after the mark fails the check. 1a-reading: step 2 is the turn-page hook: 0.8 s of the still page, then the turn. 1b-voices: the only step a 6 s hold while the read goes: its last 3 s. 2-record: the sheet closes at 15.8 s but the Your voice intro only comes up at 19.0 s (3 s of plain shelf between), so the clip is the intro: step 4 waits for it (ends 20.17 s, 1.2 s after it shows); 1.7 s before that end keeps 0.5 s of shelf and 3.5 s of the intro. 3-language-*: the only step a 3 s hold: its last 1 s. 4-shelf: step 2 is the first scroll hook: 0.5 s of the still shelf, then the scroll.
